nodes.label: Revvbase
nodes.rationale: A dedicated mobile-first used two-wheeler marketplace fills the gap between generic classifieds and car-only trusted marketplaces in India.

nodes.label: Five-Minute Frictionless Listing
nodes.rationale: The product prioritizes rapid seller supply creation and buyer evaluation without calls, middlemen, or friction.

nodes.label: Mobile-First Native App
nodes.rationale: Indian users are mobile-first and app-store presence is expected to improve trust.

nodes.label: Low-Complexity MVP Stack
nodes.rationale: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Railway, Cloudinary, and MSG91 were selected to keep infrastructure below $20 per month while preserving future scalability.

nodes.label: V1 Browse and Detail Requirements
nodes.source_location: v1 Requirements / Browse and Vehicle Detail

nodes.label: Accumulated Architectural Invariants
nodes.rationale: PostGIS and JSONB are established up front; signed direct uploads, SecureStore, FlashList, memoized cards, and keyset pagination prevent costly retrofits.

nodes.label: Backend Foundation Plan
nodes.rationale: The permanent schema and Railway PostGIS provisioning are handled first because every later phase depends on them and they are expensive to reverse.

nodes.label: Cloudinary and MSG91 Integration Services Plan
nodes.rationale: Isolating external APIs behind services makes later authentication and listing work depend on stable internal contracts rather than external-service research.
nodes.norm_label: cloudinary and msg91 integration services plan

nodes.label: Expo Frontend Scaffold Plan
nodes.rationale: Theme, navigation, fonts, auth storage, and API client setup are centralized early so later phases can focus on feature screens.

nodes.label: Domain-Driven Frontend Backend Monorepo
nodes.rationale: A top-level frontend/backend split and backend auth/listings/users domains keep boundaries simple and explicit.

nodes.label: Auth Guard Bottom Sheet
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated Create or Profile taps show a sign-in sheet without navigating away, preserving the user's current context.

nodes.label: Migration 001 Marketplace Schema
nodes.rationale: All four core tables, UUIDs, soft deletion, JSONB, and nullable PostGIS geography are created up front because schema decisions are permanent.

nodes.label: Context-Driven Swappable Theme
nodes.rationale: Typed semantic tokens accessed only through useTheme make dark/light toggles and whole-theme replacement a provider-level change.

nodes.label: Selected Foundation Options Audit Trail
nodes.source_location: Repo Structure, Navigation, DB Schema, Design Token Loading

nodes.label: Universal Theme Access Pattern
nodes.rationale: All frontend components consume semantic theme values through useTheme rather than hardcoded color literals.

nodes.label: Backend Dependency Injection Pattern
nodes.rationale: FastAPI dependencies provide settings, database sessions, and current-user context consistently to route handlers.

nodes.label: PostGIS Alembic Safety Pattern
nodes.rationale: Migration 001 creates PostGIS explicitly and Alembic excludes PostGIS system tables from autogeneration.

nodes.label: Mockable OTP Service
nodes.rationale: A configuration switch enables deterministic development authentication while retaining a path to the real MSG91 service.

nodes.label: Signed Direct Image Upload
nodes.rationale: Device-to-Cloudinary upload avoids metered Railway bandwidth and latency while a server-issued signature prevents unauthorized account use.

nodes.label: Keyset-Paginated Listing Feed
nodes.rationale: Cursor pagination avoids offset degradation and duplicate or missing feed items as new listings arrive.

nodes.label: Validated JSONB Vehicle Attributes
nodes.rationale: JSONB supports vehicle-type-specific fields without EAV joins or repeated migrations and remains queryable through GIN indexes.

nodes.label: Repository and Service Separation
nodes.rationale: Routers own HTTP concerns, services own business logic, and models own persistence so core behavior stays independently testable.

nodes.label: Thin Supply-Demand MVP Loop
nodes.rationale: Launch scope centers on OTP identity, structured photo listings, browsing, detail, and seller management; chat and advanced trust features wait for validation.

nodes.label: OTP Bombing Risk
nodes.rationale: Unprotected SMS endpoints can rapidly exhaust MSG91 credits, so per-phone and per-IP rate limits plus a provider spend cap precede public exposure.

nodes.label: Refresh Token Cycle
nodes.rationale: Implementing refresh with OTP auth avoids silent mid-session logout and a later cross-cutting retrofit.

nodes.label: Feed Performance Controls
nodes.rationale: Memoized recycled list cards, eager-loaded data, and feed indexes prevent UI jank and database N+1 collapse.

nodes.label: GSD Workflow Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Repository changes must begin through quick, debug, or execute-phase GSD entry points so planning artifacts remain synchronized.
